theory.heading: What AI for Documentation is
theory.body: AI for Documentation describes the methods and patterns used within Vibe Coding with AI to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why AI for Documentation matters
theory.body: Without AI for Documentation, systems built with Vibe Coding with AI are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How AI for Documentation works
theory.body: The mechanism behind AI for Documentation follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of AI for Documentation.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of AI for Documentation
theory.body: AI for Documentation offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
